plain: This story is about David Grusch, a US intelligence whistleblower who spoke out in 2023. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Grusch and others have made statements that real government programs are reverse engineering, meaning taking apart and copying, recovered craft kept in hangars. A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, sums up Grusch's message as: UFOs are real, and we are reverse engineering them. Corbell says Grusch also spoke of non-human biological remains and of decades spent using technologies derived from the craft. He ties these claims to a complaint Grusch filed with the ICIG, the official watchdog for the US spy agencies. If true, it would mean the US government has hidden non-human technology for generations.
